req.title: Redirect count boundary
req.statement: The system shall accept /redirect/<n> with n in the range 1..30 inclusive and reject values above.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the /redirect/<n> endpoint should accept values of n between 1 and 30 inclusive, returning a 2xx response, and reject values above 30, returning a 4xx response. This requires testing for valid inputs within the range, invalid inputs above the range, and boundary values at the edges of the range.

tests.name: test_redirect_valid
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/redirect/5')
assert response.status_code == 302

tests.name: test_redirect_invalid
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/redirect/31')
assert response.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_redirect_boundary
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/redirect/30')
assert response.status_code == 302
